info.title: Email Draft Approval API
info.description: Agents create, revise and submit email Drafts; a human Reviewer approves or rejects the submitted Revision in the Review UI, and an Approval sends the email through Resend. Every route except this document requires a bearer token. Errors use the `ErrorResponse` envelope. Send the latest `X-Read-Bookmark` you received on every request to read your own writes.

get.description: Returns one page of Draft summaries, without bodies, filtered by review status and sending status and ordered by `orderBy` and `order`, ties broken by the Draft id. Repeating a filter parameter matches any of its values; different filters must all match. Read further pages by passing `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same filters and ordering. The Review UI's Pending list is `reviewStatus=PENDING&order=asc` (longest-waiting first); its Decided list is `reviewStatus=APPROVED&reviewStatus=REJECTED` (newest verdict first).

post.description: Creates the Draft's next Revision, `UNSUBMITTED`, from the given Draft data. `baseRevisionId` names the Revision the change builds on, the latest Revision as you last read it; if another revise came first, nothing is written and the result is 409 `REVISION_SUPERSEDED`, which guards against lost updates and against duplicate Revisions from retries. Revising supersedes an Unsubmitted or Pending base, which withdraws its Submission; a Rejected base stays Rejected. Revising never submits: submit the new Revision separately. An approved Draft accepts no further Revisions.

post.description: Submits one specific Revision, the Draft's latest and `UNSUBMITTED`, for the Reviewer's verdict; the Revision and the Draft become `PENDING`. Takes no request body. Each Revision is submitted at most once. Revising the Draft afterwards supersedes the Pending Revision, which withdraws its Submission until you submit the new Revision.

409.description: In order of precedence: `DRAFT_APPROVED`: the Draft is approved and accepts no Submission, also of its approved Revision. `REVISION_SUPERSEDED`: the Revision is no longer the Draft's latest; read the Draft again and submit its latest Revision. `REVISION_ALREADY_DECIDED`: the Revision already has a verdict, named in `existingVerdict`; revise the Draft to submit a new Revision. `REVISION_ALREADY_SUBMITTED`: the Revision is already Pending, for example because an earlier attempt of this request went through.

post.description: Reviewer only. Approves exactly the Revision you loaded, provided it is still the Draft's latest and `PENDING`; takes no request body. The Approval records the Draft's one Send intent: the Draft becomes `APPROVED` with sending status `QUEUED`, accepts no further Revisions or Submissions, and the email (recipients and content of this Revision, sender from configuration) is sent through Resend in the background. A repeated Approval never sends twice: it gets 409 `REVISION_ALREADY_DECIDED`.
